role: The flying-mob movement layer (ghast, blaze, bat): no fall damage, the air drag moveEntityWithHeading, and no ladder climbing.
scope_reason: The ghast and blaze are Nether mobs and the bat an ambient; all three are ported kinds.

members.name: fall
members.note: n/a: EntityFlying's own updateFallState is empty, so Entity.updateFallState never calls it; the other caller, Entity.fall's riddenByEntity, needs something riding a ghast

members.name: updateFallState
members.note: the empty override: fallDistance never accumulates

members.name: moveEntityWithHeading
members.note: the water and lava arms (0.02 friction, the 0.8/0.5 drags) and the air arm (slipperiness*0.91, 0.16277136/(v3*v3*v3), the all-three-motion drag); the limb-swing bookkeeping is client render

members.name: isOnLadder
members.note: false: the air arm drops the ladder clamp
